source: src/rp2040/hardware_regs/include/hardware/regs/pads_bank0.h (pico-sdk, fetched this session; VOLTAGE_SELECT at 0x00 plus GPIO0's full field layout read, GPIO1-29 same layout by convention not individually re-read)
verified: 2026-08-24 covers GPIO0's field layout as read against pads_bank0.h; not yet traced against a live simulator or hardware
instance_layout: GPIOn register at 0x04 + n*4 -- n*4 stride UNVERIFIED beyond GPIO0 at 0x04 (PADS_BANK0 packs all fields into one 8-bit-wide register per pin, unlike IO_BANK0's STATUS+CTRL pair, so 4-byte stride is the reasonable but unconfirmed assumption).

registers_per_gpio.name: GPIOn
registers_per_gpio.why_reset_value: 0x56 = OD=0, IE=1, DRIVE=01(4mA), PUE=0, PDE=1, SCHMITT=1. Every pad comes up input-enabled with pull-down and no pull-up -- a firmware bug that forgets to configure a floating input pin reads a stable 0, not noise. Matters for any conformance fixture checking 'undriven pin reads low'.

fields.name: OD
fields.why: 'Output disable. Has priority over output enable from peripherals' -- forces the pad to never drive, overriding SIO's GPIO_OE and IO_BANK0's OEOVER both. Third and last gate (after FUNCSEL==5 and SIO.GPIO_OE) blink's digitalWrite must pass through.

fields.name: DRIVE
fields.why: Not electrically meaningful for a digital-logic-level model (no analog current modeling in scope) -- included for completeness of the register map.

fields.name: PDE
fields.why: Combined with PUE, this is what an undriven-input fixture needs: PDE=1,PUE=0 at reset means floating pins read 0. A simulator that hardcodes 'floating = 0' happens to match the reset default but is wrong the moment firmware changes either bit -- must actually model PDE/PUE.

fields.name: SCHMITT
fields.why: Not electrically meaningful for a digital-logic-level model -- included for completeness.

fields.name: SLEWFAST
fields.why: UNVERIFIED this session -- inferred from bit-budget (BITS mask 0xff minus the 7 confirmed fields at bits 7-1 leaves bit 0 unaccounted). Standard RP2040 pad field name for bit 0 is SLEWFAST per general knowledge of the layout; the one field in this file not individually grepped from source.

note_on_no_spins: Same silent-failure caveat as IO_BANK0: wrong OD/IE modeling breaks GPIO conduction without hanging anything.
